recommendations.title: Refresh: Add a clear 2026 bergvärme price guide with net costs
recommendations.details: Expand the existing 'Värmepumpar i Stockholm' and 'Luft-vatten eller bergvärme' pages with a dedicated section that lists typical complete-installation price ranges for bergvärme in the Stockholm area (low/median/high) and shows the net cost after ROT and Villaeffekten in kronor. Include explicit calculations using Skatteverkets schablon (35 % arbete for bergvärme) and note eligibility conditions and caps (ROT cap per person, Villaeffekten 60 000 kr cap). This will let visitors quickly see realistic post-subsidy prices.

recommendations.title: Create an interactive post-ROT price calculator
recommendations.details: Build an interactive calculator page or embedded widget where a user enters total offer price, material portion (or accept a default schablon split), and number of owners; the tool should compute ROT using the 35 % work schablon for bergvärme, apply Villaeffekten rules (30 % on material, max 60 000 kr), show applicable caps (ROT per-person cap), and output net price after deductions plus a downloadable summary. Provide explanatory text and the legal sources (Skatteverket, Boverket).

recommendations.title: Refresh: Add multiple concrete price examples and eligibility notes
recommendations.details: On the 'Luft-vatten eller bergvärme' guide and 'Grönt avdrag' page, add a small table or set of bullet examples showing several typical total-offer prices and the resulting ROT, Villaeffekten and net cost for 1- and 2-owner households, plus a clear note about ROT and grönt avdrag not being combinable for the same work. Clarify the apparent differing cap numbers by citing the correct 2026 caps and where 75 000 kr vs 50 000 kr references apply.
